note: The third-party assets and code Walkdown Plant carries, besides the Godot Engine (its own notices come from Engine.get_license_info() and Engine.get_copyright_info() at run time, decision 0054 §7) and the sounds (synthesised by tools/plant3d/sounds; any recorded clip has its licence in data/plant3d/sounds.json). Geometry and the weathering's noise are made by the build itself.
